title: Ammu nahi aaye
body:
AMMU NAHI AAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE
THE SHAAM-O-SEHAR LAB PE SAKINA KE YEH NAALEY AMMU NAHI AAYE, DARIYA SE KOI MERE CHACHA JAAN KO BULAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE
KYO ROOTH GAYE MUJH SE MERE CHAHNE WALE AMMU NAHI AAYE, KIS HAAL MEIN MAIN HOO YEH BHI TO POOCHA NA KISI NE AMMU NAHI AAYE
HAR SIMTH SITAMGAAR HAI KOI NAHI MERA MAIN KYA KAROO BABA, FARIYAAD KARU BHI TO KARU BOLO MAIN KIS SE AMMU NAHI AAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
AYE BABA MERE KANAO SE KHOO BEHTA HAI DEKHO TAKLEEF HAI MUJH KO, IS TARHA GOHAR SHIMR-E-SITAMGAAR NE CHEENEY AMMU NAHI AAYE
KYA KOI YAHA SAHEB-E-AULAD NAHI HAI YEH LOOG HAI KAISE, DETA NAHI KOI BHI YATEEMAO KO DILASA AMMU NAHI AAYE
BANDHI GAYI BAZU MEIN RASAN SHAAM-E-GARIBAA THE KAISE MUSALMAA, LOOTA GAYA ASBAAB JALAYE GAYE KHAIME AMMU NAHI AAYE
SAR BAAP KI GODI ME LIYE BOLI SAKINA DUSHWAAR HAI JEENA, BABA ZARA DEKHO MERE RUKHSAAR HAI NEELEY AMMU NAHI AAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
ZINDAAN NAHI SHAAM KA YEH MAUT KA GHAR HAI LAGTA MUJHEY DAR HAI, GHUT GHUT KE KAYI MAR GAYE ZINDAAN ME BACHCHAY AMMU NAHI AAYE
DIL MEHAI KAYI DIN SE WATAN JAANE KA ARMAA KEHTI THI YE NADAA, AB KAUN CHUDAYE MUJEH ZINDAAN-E-BALA SE AMMU NAHI AAYE
CHUP HO GAYI SAHIL YAHI KEH KEH KE SAKINA MATAM HUVA BARPA, AMMU NAHI AAYE MERE AMMU NAHI AAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE
